hooks.command: python -c "import os,json,sys; d=json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')); p=d.get('file_path',''); sys.exit(1 if 'config.json' in p and 'example' not in p else 0)" || (echo 'ERROR: Direct edits to config.json are blocked. Use config.json.example as a reference or update values via set_config_value() in config_utils.py.' && exit 1)

python -c "import os,json,sys; d=json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')); p=d.get('file_path',''); sys.exit(0 if p.endswith('.po') else 1)" && python -c "import os,json; p=json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')).get('file_path',''); loc=p.split('messages_')[1][:2] if 'messages_' in p else ''; print(loc)" | xargs -I{} sh -c 'msgfmt src/messages_{}.po -o res/messages_{}.mo && echo "hook success: compiled res/messages_{}.mo"' || true
